what_happened: The job "write test stand-in scripts via one helper that avoids ETXTBSY" ended failed. A decisions check refused it: the change touches crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs, which docs/decisions.md covers under D08. The job added no entry to docs/decisions.md that amends, supersedes or confirms D08. It also added no [[link]] in docs/decision-links.toml from D08 to a new entry. This was a failed check. It was not an unmet acceptance criterion, and no criterion is listed as judged.
cause: The decision-reconcile rule is enforced only after the work is done. Neither the reading nor the plan lists which decisions govern the files a job is likely to touch. A helper meant for tests reached into a decision-covered production file, snapshot.rs, and nothing warned the producer before it edited that file. Reconciling a decision is not part of the job's deliverables unless someone adds it. The class differs from the registry's stale-decision class (20261104-153440-xf17) because here the change may not contradict D08 at all. The failure is the missing record and link.
prevention: Add a pre-dispatch step that maps the files a plan names to the decisions in docs/decisions.md that cover them. It would add "reconcile decision Dxx: entry in decisions.md plus [[link]] in decision-links.toml" to the deliverables and criteria for those files. The producer would be given the same list. The producer would also run the same decisions check locally before it reports. Either the files are covered and the reconcile work is planned, or the plan keeps the change out of decision-covered files.
proposed_request: Re-do the job "write test stand-in scripts via one helper that avoids ETXTBSY". Outcome: test stand-in scripts are created through one shared helper that avoids the ETXTBSY error (text file busy), and the tests that write such scripts use it. The change touches crates/athena-git/src/snapshot.rs, which decision D08 in docs/decisions.md covers. So also add an entry to docs/decisions.md that says D08 was checked and stands, or amends it if behavior changes. Add a matching [[link]] in docs/decision-links.toml whose older is D08 and whose newer is the new entry. Acceptance: the decisions check passes; the full test suite passes; no stand-in script writer outside the helper is left in the touched tests; the diff is limited to the helper, its call sites, docs/decisions.md, docs/decision-links.toml and CHANGELOG.md.
